narration: In month {fork_month} the landlord asked for more, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The ghost's {first_bar_apart} pulled away from yours that same month, and by month {ghost_lowest_month} its money had touched its lowest point since the split. In month {crossover_month} the ghost's net worth passed yours, and it stayed ahead for the {ghost_ahead_months} months that remained. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Less of the ghost's pay was committed before each month began, and its Freedom ended {freedom_gap}.
